landscape.detail: Read-only tool to get current account IBAN
Effectful tool to send money to a recipient
Effectful tool to schedule a future transaction
Effectful tool to modify a scheduled transaction
Read-only tool to check account balance
Read-only tool to list recent transactions
Read-only tool to list scheduled transactions
Read-only tool to read file contents
Read-only tool to get user profile data
Effectful tool to change account password
Effectful tool to modify user profile
